policy: Batch 013 reuses POSITIVE_CONSTRAINT_RULESET_V1 unchanged. The rare-earths case deliberately exercises the open-contradiction to UNEVALUABLE path.

cases.rationale: Food-price inflation accelerated in the expected direction, but FAO explicitly attributed the observed rise to both ruble depreciation and the food embargo; the embargo is therefore not treated as a sole cause.

Restricted advanced-computing shipments faced licensing barriers and NVIDIA reported no licenses for specified restricted China products plus a China Data Center revenue share below pre-control levels, but subsequent 2023 control updates and product redesign/adaptation prevent clean attribution to the October 2022 rule alone.

The challenged duties, quotas and specified trading-right restrictions were reported removed, but the WTO record preserves a U.S. concern that a remaining licensing requirement could itself restrict exports and records disagreement over full compliance. The case therefore remains UNEVALUABLE rather than forcing a compliance verdict.
